page_note: Page is heavily damaged (82.4%) but every legible segment is cosmological substrate. The teaching concerns: (1) the twelve ascendings plus the Call and Hearing (Father and Mother), (2) Jesus the Radiance in his likeness, (3) the parable/likeness of the First Man — a noble offspring surrounded by enemies who strip his wealth, captivity, abasement, kept in stillness — and (4) the likeness of the Living Spirit sent from the Greatness as a judge-king to avenge the violence done to the First Man. This is core Manichaean cosmological narrative, impersonal-systematic register throughout. No dialogue frame, no institutional vocabulary, no exhortation, no contemporary application. The 'King who will send a judge' is the Father of Greatness within the cosmic system, not an editorial figure.
